extras.egress_verbatim: NOT STATED on the product page. What is published is bandwidth shape only: 'Peak Bandwidth 1.000 MBit / Guaranteed bandwidth 300 MBit'. No traffic volume, no unlimited claim, no overage rate. This is the one number that decides whether the €1.25/TB headline is real.
extras.price_verbatim: RYZ5-20 €109.99 ÷ 88 TB = €1.25/TB/mo raw ≈$1.45 — the lowest €/TB of the storage providers compared. RYZ5-12 €79.99 ÷ 56 TB = €1.43/TB. RYZ7-20 €119.99 ÷ 88 = €1.36/TB. Caveat: egress term unpublished; treat as unverified until confirmed in writing.
extras.agent_focus: Cheapest per-TB-month storage VPS and Storage Boxes in Europe. Price floor hunt with egress as the deciding term. Tiers recorded at 1TB/5TB/10TB/20TB. Excludes AWS/Azure/GCP/Alibaba/R2/B2/iDrive e2 per client instruction.
